errors.text_span: най-късият стълб е през 2014 г., достигайки общо ниво от около 130 000 тона
errors.evidence: The description identifies 2014 as the year with the shortest bar (lowest total production), with a value of about 130,000 tons. However, a close inspection of the chart shows the bar for 2020 is visibly shorter than the one for 2014. The 2014 bar slightly exceeds 130,000 tons, while the 2020 bar is lower, at approximately 125,000 tons.
